scope: Liquid Agility occupied-target throw evasion timing repair for the source cutoff after APD442.
apd442_separation: The APD442 remote run remains pinned to its original producing source df0c0b44. This repair is not present in that frozen build.

failures.message: java.lang.AssertionError: Rank 2 potion throw should protect the following enemy turn expected:<1000000> but was:<5>
java.lang.AssertionError: Rank 1 potion throw should protect the following enemy turn expected:<15> but was:<5>

original_expected_red.behavior: Real Item.cast occupied-target callback creates a zero-duration EVA tracker before charging the throw. Real Actor.process expires it before the MOB_PRIO observer calls real Hero.defenseSkill. Both ranks return base defense 5 instead of15 /1000000.
original_expected_red.controls: Four methods passed: empty throws at both ranks, real ordinary/factor 2 drinks, actual multi-output Aqua proc/no-proc casts, and excluded Strength throw.

initial_fixture_failure.explanation: In addition to the two intended timing failures, the first fixture had two control failures because its observer blocked the empty throw ray, and one Strength-drink error because Badges.global was uninitialized. The fixture moved the observer off that ray and called normal Badges.loadGlobal. Production was unchanged.

repair.item: Protected completion hook runs on the detached item after the occupied callback resolves its original paid/free decision and before next(). Paid action retains busy()+spend(delay); Lethal Momentum is still consumed only after impact and still skips spending.
repair.potion: Throw-start clears temporary context. Only the existing successful eligible potion-talent hook can record the exact EVA tracker and existing extra-factor time. Completion clears context first, requires the same tracker still in the user buff list, and uses existing max/prolong behavior with actual post-cost cooldown.
repair.unchanged: No eligibility, random roll, chance, potion splash/hit, accuracy-use, other potion-talent formula or save field was changed.

additional_guards: Removed tracker is not recreated despite retained Buff.target
Replacement tracker keeps its independent deadline
Longer existing deadline is preserved on a stacked throw
Occupied chance-failed Aqua does not extend an unrelated tracker
One-shot completion and real Item Bundle round-trip
Actual Slow, Speed and combined action costs
Free Lethal Momentum and actual Time Freeze / Time Bubble interception
preservation_assertions: Real fire clearing and Aqua water
Identification retained on throws and performed on drinks

aqua_baseline_comparison.meaning: Observed deterministic multi-output behavior and all recorded outcomes stayed identical across the frozen baseline and fixed source. This is not a statistical probability estimate.

current_limits: Headless rendering substitutes only texture/animation operations; real production completion callbacks, potion effects, scheduler and defense lookup execute.
The scheduler observer reads the real defense score rather than performing a randomized damaging attack.
The new suite directly covers excluded Strength and failed Aqua; well/pit/anonymous eligibility gates were preserved and source-reviewed, without new dedicated cases.
Native Android execution, affected screenshot review and APK acceptance for this next cutoff remain pending.
No GitHub operations were performed by this agent.
independent_review: Agent apd_lineage reported no blocker after reviewing the production diff and all 13 new methods.
